definition: The act of bringing something under another's control by force.
author: H. G. Wells
quote: The whole world will be intelligent, educated, and co-operating; things will move faster and faster towards the subjugation of Nature.
example_sentence: My weekends are spent in the slow subjugation of the brambles.
